decisions: Bare Hilbert-Schmidt metric learning is known; linear binary-risk identity is not a40class CE/Macro theorem. No new training candidate selected from this alone.
The original model already keeps signed key-value pairing; fractional Rayleigh form was used in previous attainable-routing audit. Current algebra is not newT or a newly implemented readout.

Ordinary state-QFI/natural-gradient, normalized-attention Fisher, word/relation square-root frames, independent amplitude/phase and entity-transition paths already have separate stopped profiles. This source is not permission to restart them.

Pure-pair averaged Helstrom proxy has a mathematical counterexample and is not selected. This is a bounded transfer rejection, not a ban on correct mixed-state discrimination or all metric regularization.
